items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated Thu 19.11.2026 and no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so posting day = 19.11.2026. Per the letter's own clause and § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, delivery (Bekanntgabe) is the 4th day after posting: 19.11.2026 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday). Since this is a tax office, if that day were a Saturday, Sunday or holiday it would move to the next working day, but Mon 23.11.2026 is an ordinary working day, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, counted per § 108 Abs. 1 AO with §§ 187, 188 BGB) ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of delivery: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed.
